answer: A sybil needs many identities that look independent, so the cheapest defence is to make independence cost time. Tie lotus to a record no new account can borrow: standing that only grows when peers whose own standing is older attest your work. A fresh dawn starts at zero. Running two hundred accounts earns nothing until each one has been graded by strangers for several epochs, and the attacker pays rent on every one of them meanwhile. The pearl is not secrecy but sequence.
